g2_g3_inference.noise_floor_note: same model, same batch, same transfer path run twice: this is the kernel-reduction-order noise that exists without any code change

g6_labels_and_test_isolation.nan_policy: unobserved (NaN) entries are excluded from the loss, never filled with 0

decision.label: PERF_OPTIMIZATION_ACCEPTED
decision.rule: PERF_OPTIMIZATION_ACCEPTED iff every correctness gate passes and end-to-end step throughput improves >= 1.5x

cache.cache_sha256_limitation: not re-hashed in this round: hashing 4.5 GB would evict the page cache and change the measured mmap read pattern

batch_plan.source: torch.Generator().manual_seed(0) + torch.randperm(len(train_rows)) -> the exact prefix of the seed-0 epoch order in pc_train._batches

drift_check.note: same host, same batches, after the B pass; guards against clock drift

projected_epoch.note: pure train-step projection, Validation and logging excluded

speedup.definition: end_to_end_wall = step/s(B) / step/s(A) over the identical 300 steps (total wall A / total wall B); p50/mean = per-step-time ratios. >1 means B is faster
